highlights.title: Saudi Arabia Downs Houthi Missiles Targeting Kingdom, Official Says
highlights.summary: The Iran-backed militia in Yemen fired six ballistic missiles at cities in Saudi Arabia, a military spokesman said. There was no immediate comment from the Houthis.
